source.authoredBasis: New written-source graph sheet, not an original. Six separate complete frames A-F each plot y=x^2. Their lines are respectively -3x+4,2x+5,-2x-5,x/2+3/2,-2x/3+5/3,-12x/5+2. These divide every term by the original leading coefficient when needed. Root abscissas are respectively {-4,1},{1-sqrt(6),1+sqrt(6)},none,{-1,3/2},{-5/3,1},{(-6-sqrt(86))/5,(-6+sqrt(86))/5}. Exact quadratic Bezier paths, not guessed curves. No root labels, highlighted answers, or deliberate false geometry.
